sec_q9ggb3-d070-34v: 科普启蒙篇 butterflies life cycle sec_q9ggb3-d070-34v english text 蝴蝶是拥有斑斓翅膀的美丽飞虫。 butterflies are beautiful flying insects with colorful wings. 它们的一生会经历四个截然不同的阶段，这场奇妙的变化就叫做生命周期。 they go through four totally different stages in their whole life, and this amazing change is called a life cycle. 首先，成蝴蝶会在绿叶背面产下细小的虫卵。 first, an adult butterfly lays tiny eggs on the back of green leaves. 几天之后，毛毛虫就从卵中孵化出来。 after a few days, small caterpillars hatch out from the eggs. 毛毛虫会不停地啃食树叶，慢慢长大长壮。 caterpillars eat leaves and continue to grow bigger and stronger. 当发育成熟后，毛毛虫便会停止进食，把自己包裹起来变成。 when they grow up enough, the caterpillars will stop eating and wrap themselves up to become chrysalises. 的内部正在发生巨大的蜕变。 inside the chrysalis, great changes are taking place. 最终，一只漂亮的蝴蝶破茧而出，开启全新的生命旅程。 finally, a lovely butterfly breaks out and starts its new life. chinese translation knowledge summary mini exercise butterfly/ 'bxtaflai / n. 蝴蝶 cycle / 'sarkl / n. 周期 egg / eg / n. 卵 caterpillar / ‘ketapil / n. 毛毛虫 chrysalis / 'krrsalis / n. 蛹 2. 判断： caterpillar turns into chrysalis.(t / f) 单词 page b butterflies life cycle 蝴蝶蜕变

science-d001-j79: 科普进阶篇 the secrets of ice cream production science-d001-j79 the secrets of ice cream production. ice cream is the most popular treat on hot summer days. it is cold and smooth on the tongue when you lick it, and its sweet taste melts away instantly on your tongue. do you like eating ice cream? technically, ice cream is a complex frozen dessert. it is made from milk, fresh cream, sugar, and flavorings. it comes in rich colors and delicious tastes. while it helps people beat the summer heat, it is primarily loved for bringing joy to children and adults in hot weather. step 1. prepare the ice cream base. workers mix all raw materials evenly, filter out impurities, homogenize the mixture, and pasteurize it to kill bacteria. after cooling the mixture below 10 degrees celsius, add fruit flavorings and cool it further to 0–5 degrees celsius. step 2. aging. put the cooled base into cans and leave it to stand for several hours. this process greatly improves the smooth texture of ice cream. step 3. churning and freezing. churn the base continuously while freezing it. air is incorporated into the liquid mixture, turning it into soft, fluffy, semi-solid ice cream. step 4. packaging and hardening. quickly fill the cups with soft ice cream, then transfer them to a freezer at negative 40 degrees celsius for deep hardening! once fully solidified, the finished ice cream is ready. 冰淇淋制作的秘密。 在炎热的夏日，冰淇淋是最受欢迎的甜品。 当你舔它时，舌头会感到冰凉而光滑，而它那甜美的味道会在舌尖上瞬间融化。 你喜欢吃冰淇淋吗？ 从技术上讲，冰淇淋是一种复杂的冷冻甜点。 它是由牛奶、鲜奶油、糖和调味料制成的。 它色彩丰富，味道鲜美。 虽然它能帮助人们抵御夏日炎热，但人们主要还是喜欢它在炎热的天气里给儿童和成人带来欢乐。 第一步。 准备好冰淇淋底料。 工作人员将所有原材料均匀混合，过滤掉杂质，使混合物均匀化，并对其进行巴氏杀菌以杀死细菌。 将混合物冷却至10摄氏度以下后，加入水果调味料，再进一步冷却至0至5摄氏度。 第二步。 陈化。将冷却后的基底装入罐中，静置数小时。 这一过程大大提升了冰淇淋的口感顺滑度。 第三步。 翻腾和冻结。 在冷冻的过程中，要不断地搅拌基底。 空气被融入液体混合物中，使其变成柔软蓬松的半固体冰淇淋。 步骤4。 包装与硬化。 快往杯子里装满软冰淇淋，然后转移到零下40摄氏度的冰箱里进行深度硬化！ 一旦完全凝固，成品冰淇淋就做好了。

science-d066-9pr: 科普进阶篇 where does wind come from? science-d066-9pr where does wind come from? 风是从哪里来的？ have you ever felt the wind blowing on your face? 你感受过风吹在脸上的感觉吗？ it moves your hair, shakes the trees, and carries kites high up in the sky. 它吹动你的头发，摇晃大树，把风筝高高地送上天空。 but where does wind come from? 但风是从哪里来的呢？ let's find out! 我们一起来看看吧！ wind comes from the sun. 风来自太阳。 the sun heats the earth, but it does not heat everything evenly. 太阳加热地球，但它并不是均匀地加热每一个地方，有些地方会比另一些地方更热。 some places get hotter than others. 地面附近的空气受热后，会上升飘向天空。 when the air near the ground gets warm, it rises up into the sky. 较冷的空气就涌过来填补空位。 cooler air rushes in to take its place. 这些流动的空气，就是我们所说的风！ this moving air is what we call wind! 风可以吹得很轻，也可以吹得非常猛。 the wind can blow gently or very strongly. 微风在热天能帮你降温，强风能把大树吹倒，甚至损坏房屋。 a gentle breeze can cool you down on a hot day. 暴风和腿风就是由非常强的风形成的。 a strong windcanblowdown treesand even damagehouses. 风也很有用一它帮助植物传播种子和授粉。 storms and hurricanes are made of very powerful wind. 人们还利用风能来航行，或者用风力发电机来发电。 wind is also very useful. 所以下次你感觉到微风拂过脸庞时，记住一一是太阳和空气一起合作，产生了风！ it helps spread seeds and pollinate flowers. 核心单词 people use wind energy to sail boats and make electricity with wind turbines. so next time you feel the breeze on your face, remember — it is the sun and the air working together to create wind! wind /wind/ 风 breeze /bri:z/ 微风 sun /s∧n/ 太阳 heat /hi:t/ 加热 rise /raiz/ 上升 energy /'enad3j/ 能量 turbine /'t3:rbain/ 涡轮机

sec_qslfuq-d031-rb5: 科普进阶篇 why are tree trunks painted white? sec_qslfuq-d031-rb5 why are tree trunks painted white? have you ever seen trees with white trunks? they look nice, but there is a very good reason for it. in winter, the sun can still be bright. dark tree bark absorbs sunlight and gets warm during the day. at night, the temperature drops quickly, and the bark becomes cold again. this big change can make the bark crack. white paint reflects sunlight, so the trunk stays cooler during the day. then the temperature change is smaller, and the bark stays safe. the white paint is not just ordinary paint. it is usually made with lime, salt, and sometimes sulfur. this mixture can kill small germs and insects on the bark. it also stops treesforhundreds of years! some bugs from climbing up the tree. so, white paint is like a sunscreen and a coat for trees. it keeps them healthy and safe. 中文翻译 为什么树干要涂成白色？ 你见过树干被涂成白色的树吗？ 它们看起来很好看，但背后有一个很重要的原因。 冬天，阳光依然很明亮。 深色的树皮会吸收阳光，白天变暖。 到了晚上，温度迅速下降，树皮又变冷。 这种巨大的温差会让树皮开裂。 白色的涂料能反射阳光，让树干在白天保持较凉的温度。 这样温差就变小了，树皮也就安全了。 这种白色涂料不是普通的油漆，通常由石灰、盐，有时还有硫磺制成。 这种混合物可以杀死树皮上的小细菌和昆虫，还能阻止一些虫子爬上树。 所以，白色涂料就像树木的防晒霜和外套，让它们保持健康和安全。

science-d008-dyd: 用英文讲好中国故事 national day – a celebration of our great country science-d008-dyd national day, a celebration of our great country. october 1st is a very special day for every chinese person. it is china's national day. on this day in 1949, the people's republic of china was founded. every year we celebrate this day with joy and pride. when we see the 5 -star red flag flying in the sky we feel proud. the flag is bright red, like a flame that lights up the land. the five stars on the flag shine together showing the unity of the chinese people. china is a country with a long history and a rich culture. it has beautiful mountains, long rivers, and many great cities. the chinese people are hardworking, brave, and kind. they love their country, and are always ready to help each other. national day reminds us of the hard work and sacrifice of those who came before us. they built our country and gave us a better life. it also reminds us to be grateful and to work hard for a brighter future. many people celebrate by traveling, spending time with family, or watching the flag raising ceremony. but no matter how we celebrate, we all share one thing love for our country. happy national day! may our country always be strong and prosperous. 国庆节，是我们伟大祖国的庆典。 10月1日对每一个中国人来说都是一个非常特殊的日子。 今天是中国的国庆节。 1949年的这一天，中华人民共和国成立了。 每年我们都满怀喜悦和自豪地庆祝这一天。 当我们看到五星红旗在天空中飘扬时，我们感到自豪。 这面旗帜鲜红如火，如同照亮大地的火焰。 国旗上的五颗星星共同闪耀，象征着中国人民的团结。 中国是一个历史悠久、文化丰富的国家。 它有美丽的山脉、悠长的河流和许多大城市。 中国人民勤劳、勇敢、善良。 他们热爱自己的国家，总是乐于互相帮助。 国庆节让我们想起那些前辈们的辛勤工作和牺牲。 他们建设了我们的国家，并为我们带来了更美好的生活。 它还提醒我们要心怀感激，并为更美好的未来而努力。 许多人通过旅行、与家人共度时光或观看升旗仪式来庆祝。 但无论我们如何庆祝，我们都共同拥有一个特质——对祖国的热爱。 国庆节快乐！ 愿我们的国家永远强大繁荣。

re-d031-hwd: 用英文讲好中国故事 shadow puppetry re-d031-hwd shadow puppetry: stories behind a screen 非物质文化遗产 readand learn 皮影戏是一种古老的中国讲故事艺术，已有两千多年的历史。 shadow puppetry is an ancient chinese art of storytelling. 传说汉武帝失去了心爱的妃子，非常思念她。 it began over 2,000 years ago. 一位术士用灯光让她的影子在幕布上移动，皮影戏就这样诞生了。 legend says that emperor wu of the han dynasty lost his favorite wife. 制作皮影时，艺人会选择兽皮，比如牛皮或羊皮。 he missed her so much that a magician made her shadow move on a screen using light. 他们把皮削薄，雕刻出精美的花纹，再涂上鲜艳的颜色，最后在四肢装上小棍。 this is how shadow puppetry was born. 一个好皮影可能要花几周才能完成！ to make a puppet, artists choose animal skin, like cow or sheep skin. 表演时，艺人们站在白色幕布后面，把皮影贴近幕布，操纵小棍。 they cut it into thin pieces, then carve beautiful patterns. 明亮的灯光从后面照过来，观众就能看到彩色的影子。 after that, they paint it with bright colors. 艺人们还会为角色唱歌、说话，有时甚至演奏音乐！ finally, they attach sticks to the arms andlegs. 如今，皮影戏被列入联合国教科文组织非物质文化遗产名录。 a goodpuppet can take weeks to finish! during a show, puppeteers stand behind a white clothscreen. theyhold the puppets close to the screen and move the sticks. a bright lamp shines from behind, so the audience seescolorful shadows. the puppeteers also sing and speak for the characters. sometimes they even play music! today, shadow puppetry is a unesco intangible cultural heritage. many schools and museums teachit to children. some artists use modern technology, like led lights and videos, to make it more exciting. this old art keeps shining in new ways. shadow/faedau/ 影子 carve/ka:v/ 雕刻 audience/'o:dians/ 观众 puppetry/papitri/ 木偶戏 legend/led3and/ 传说 pattern/'paetan/ 图案 screen/skri:n/ 幕布 heritage /'heritid3/ 遗产

re-d015-w5b: 用英文讲好中国故事 chopstick culture re-d015-w5b chopstick culture 筷子是世界上最古老的进食工具之一，已有三千多年的历史。 read and learn 很久以前，古代中国人用树枝从热锅中夹取食物。 chopsticks are one of the oldest eating tools in the world. 后来，筷子成为数亿人每天使用的工具。 they have a history of more than 3,000 years. 大多数筷子由竹子或木头制成，也有一些是塑料、金属甚至象牙做的。 long ago, ancient chinese people used sticks to pick up food from hot pots. 使用时，下面的筷子保持不动，上面的筷子像小杠杆一样活动。 later, chopsticks became a daily tool for millions of people. 多加练习，你就能夹起米饭、面条，甚至一颗碗豆！ most chopsticks are made of bamboo or wood. 筷子有很多礼仪规矩。 some are made of plastic, metal, or even ivory. 不要把筷子竖直插在米饭里一一这看起来像葬礼上的香。 to use them, hold the lower stick still and move the upper stick like a small lever. 不要用筷子指着别人，也不要用筷子敲碗。 with practice, you can pick up rice, noodles, and even a single pea! 在中国、日本、韩国和越南，人们每天都用筷子，但每个国家的筷子风格不同。 chopsticks come with rules. 比如，韩国筷子常常是金属的，而中国筷子更长。 never stick them upright in your rice——-this looks like incense at a funeral. 学习筷子文化不只是学会吃饭，更是学会尊重、耐心和传统。 don't point at people with them, and never use them to hit a bowl. 所以下次拿起筷子时，请记住：你手里握着的是一段历史。 in china, japan, korea, and vietnam, chopsticks are used every day, but each country has its own style. for example, korean chopsticks are often metal, while chinese ones are longer. learning chopstick culture is not just about eating——it is about respect, patience, and tradition. so next time you pick up your chopsticks, remember: you are holding a piece of history. 中文翻译: 核心词汇 chopsticks /'t{pp. 筷子 strks/ n. history /'his. 历史 tr:/ n. bamboo /baem'bu:/ n. 竹子 lever /'li:. 杠杆 var/ n. upright /sp. 竖直的 rat/ adj. funeral /'fju. 葬礼 nar. al/ n. respect /ri'spekt/ n. 尊重 tradition /tra'dif. 传统 an/ n.

re-d026-rd9: 用英文讲好中国故事 hanfu the beautiful traditional dress of china re-d026-rd9 hanfu:the beautiful traditional dress of china hanfu is the traditional clothing of the han chinese people. the name "hanfu" simply means"han clothing."ithasahistory of more than three thousand years. hanfu is known for its flowing robes, wide sleeves, and beautiful colors. unlike modern clothes, hanfu is usually madeofsilkor cottonandhasnobuttons. instead, people use a sash to tie the clothes at the waist. hanfu has many different styles. in ancient times, men and women wore different types of hanfu. men often wore long robes with a hat, while women wore skirts and jackets. the design of hanfu changed over different dynasties, such as the tang and song dynasties. each dynasty added its own beauty to the clothing. today, hanfu is becoming popular again. many young people wear hanfu to school festivals, parks, or even on the street. they love the elegant look and the feeling of connecting with chinese history. wearing hanfu is a fun way to learn about ancient culture and show pride in chinese traditions. core words 汉服是汉民族的传统服饰。 “汉服"这个名字的意思就是“汉族的衣服”。 它已经有 三千多年的历史了。 汉服以飘逸的长袍、宽大的袖子和美丽的颜色而闻名。 和现代 衣服不同，汉服通常由丝绸或棉布制成，没有纽扣。 人们用一条腰带把衣服系在腰间。 汉服有很多不同的款式。 在古代，男人和女人穿不同种类的汉服。 男人常穿长袍并戴帽子，而女人则穿裙子和上衣。 汉服的设计在不同的朝代，比如唐朝和宋朝，都有变化。 每个朝代都为服饰增添了独特的美。 如今，汉服又重新流行起来。 许多年轻人穿着汉服参加学校节日、去公园，甚至走在街上。 他们喜欢汉服优雅的外形，以及与中国历史相连的感觉。 穿汉服是了解古代文化、表达对中华传统自豪感的一种有趣方式。 traditional /tra'difanl/ 传统的 flowing /flouin/ 飘动的；流动的 sleeve /sli:v/ 袖子 sash /saef/ 腰带；饰带 dynasty /'dainasti/ 朝代 elegant /'eligant/ 优雅的 connect /ka'nekt/ 连接；联系 pride /praid/ 中自豪；骄傲

re-d029-bpd: 用英文讲好中国故事 chinese calligraphy re-d029-bpd chinese calligraphy chinese calligraphy is an ancient art of writing chinese characters with a brush. it has a history of more than three thousand years. in the past, people used calligraphy to write books, letters, and poems. today, it is stillverypopularin china and around the world. it is also a form of art. 静致走 a good piece of calligraphy can show the writer's feelings, personality, and evenmood. 中国书法是一门用毛笔书写汉字的古老艺术。 somepeople compare it to painting speed and pressure. 它已有三千多年的历史。 calligraphy is not just writing, ormusic, because it has rhythm and beauty. 过去人们用书法写书、写信、写诗。 in china, calligraphy is considered one of the highest to practice calligraphy, you need four special tools called thefour treasures of thestudy. 练习书法需要文房四宝：毛笔、墨、纸和砚台。 they are the brush made of animal hair, ink usually black, paper often ricepaper, and the inkstone used to grind the ink. 书法家能创作出优美的线条和字形，每一笔都必须认真完成。 with these tools, calligraphers create beautiful lines and shapes. 书法不仅仅是写字，也是一种艺术形式。 each stroke must be done carefully, with theright 好的作品能展现情感和个性。 forms of visual art. 学习书法帮助专注、有耐心，也能更好理解中国文化。 learning calligraphy is good foreveryone, especially students. it helps you focus, be patient, and feel calm. it also helps you understand chinese culture better. even if you are not chinese, you can enjoy the beauty of calligraphy, why not try it with a brush and ink today? 中文翻译: 核心单词 calligraphy/ka'ligrafi/ 书法 brush/braf/ 毛笔 ink/nk/ 墨 inkstone/nkstoun/ 砚台 stroke/strouk/ 笔画 rhythm/ri0om/ 节奏 patient/perfant/ 有耐心的 personality/. 个性 p3:sa'nalati/
re-d030-s98: 用英文讲好中国故事 what is the dragon boat festival re-d030-s98 read and learn* 端午节是中国一个特别的节日。 what isthe? 它在农历五月初五。 dragon boat festival? 人们庆祝它来纪念一位名叫屈原的伟大诗人。 the dragon boat festival is a special holiday in china. 他生活在很久很久以前。 it is on the fifth day of the fifth month of the lunar year. 很久以前，屈原非常热爱他的国家。 people celebrate it to remember a great poet 当他的国家遇到困难时，他很伤心。 named qu yuan. 他跳进河里，离开了人世。 he lived a very long time ago. 人们非常难过。 long ago, qu yuan loved his country very much. 他们划船去寻找他，并把米饭扔进水里喂鱼。 he was sad when his country was in trouble. 今天，我们有龙舟比赛。 he jumped into the river and died. 龙舟看起来像龙，而且非常长。 people were very sad. 队员们划船划得很快。 they rowed boats to find him and threw rice into the water tofeed thefish. 我们还吃粽子，粽子是用竹叶包起来的米团。 today, we have dragon boat races. 它们非常好吃。 the boats look like dragons and are very long. 人们还会在门上挂艾草，在手臂上系彩色丝线。 teams of people row the boats very fast. 这些是为了好运和健康。 we also eat zongzi, which are rice dumplings wrapped in bamboo leaves. 端午节是一个记住历史、和家人一起玩乐的日子。 they are very yummy. people also hang mugwort on their doors and tie colorful silk threads on their arms. these are for good luck and health. the dragon boat festival is a time to remember history and have fun with family. 中文翻译: 核心单词 festival /'festival/ 节日 celebrate /'selibret/ 庆祝 poet /'pouit/ 诗人 dragon /'dragan/ 龙 race /reis/ 比赛 zongzi /`zdnzi/ 粽子 mugwort /'magw3:rt/ 艾草 thread /0red/ 线，丝线
re-d031-bnx: 用英文讲好中国故事 dumplings: a taste of chinese tradition re-d031-bnx dumplings: 饺子是中国最有名的食物之一。 a taste of chinese tradition dumplings, called jiaozi in chinese, are one of the most famous foods in china. 传说很久以前，一位叫张仲景的聪明医生发明了饺子。 legend says that a wise doctor named zhang zhongjing invented them long ago. 他用小面皮包上肉和草药，在冬天帮人们暖耳朵。 he made small dough wrappers filled with meat and herbs to warm people's ears in winter. 所以饺子也被称为"护耳"食物。 that is why dumplings are also called "ear-protecting" food. 饺子的形状像古代中国的银元宝，代表着财富和好运。 a dumpling looks like an ancient chinese silver ingot, which means wealth and good luck. 人们常说：“吃了饺子，一年都有好运气。 people often say, "if you eat dumplings, you will have a lucky year." “包饺子是一项有趣的家庭活动。 making dumplings is a fun family activity. 首先，把面粉和水混合成面团。 first, you mix flour with water to make dough. 然后把面团擀成薄薄的圆皮。 then you roll the dough into thin circles. 接着，在中间放一勺馅料（通常是猪肉、白菜或韭菜）。 next, you put a spoon of filling (usually pork, cabbage, or chives) in the center. 最后，把边缘折起来捏紧。 finally, you fold the edges and pinch them together. 要包出完美的形状需要多练习！ it takes practice to make a perfect shape! 在中国，家人通常在春节吃饺子，尤其是除夕午夜。 in china, families usually eat dumplings during the spring festival, especially at midnight on newyear's eve. 冬至的时候也会吃饺子来保暖。 they also eat dumplings on the winter solstice to keep warm. 有些 some people hide a coin inside one dumpling. whoever finds it will have good fortune in the new year. dumplings are not just food—they are a symbol of family togetherness and happiness. 中文翻译: 核心单词 dumpling /dmplin/ 饺子 legend /"led3and/ 传说 wrapper /"raepa(r)/ 面皮，包装皮 filling /'flrn/ 馅料 dough /dau/ 面团 ingot /'ingat/ 元宝，锭 fortune /'fo:tfu:n/ 财富，运气 人会在一个饺子里藏一枚硬币，谁吃到它，新年就会有好运。 饺子不仅是食物，更是家庭 togetherness/ta'gedanas/ 团圆和幸福的象征。 团聚，亲密感

sec_cq94j8-d142-jep: xin概念 lesson 94 future champions. sec_cq94j8-d142-jep lesson 94 futurechampions 未来的冠军 what kind of race do the children compete in? experiments have proved that children can be instructed in swimming at a very early age. at a special swimming pool in los angeles, children become expert at holding their breath under water even before they can walk. babies of two months old do not appear to be reluctant to enter the water. it is not long before they are so accustomed to swimming that they can pick up weights from the floor of the pool. a game that is very popular with these young swimmers is the underwater tricycle race. tricycles are lined up on the floor of the pool seven feet under water. the children compete against each other to reach the other end of the pool. many pedal their tricycles, but most of them prefer to push or drag them. some children can cover the whole length of the pool without coming up for breath even once. whether they will ever become future olympic champions, only time will tell meanwhile, they should encourage those among us who cannot swim five yards before they are gasping for air. newwords and expressions 生词和短语 instruct /in'strakt/ v. 指导，传授 los angeles /lps'end3alas/ 洛杉矶 reluctant /r1'laktont/ adj. 勉强的，不愿意的 weight /wert/ n. 重物 underwater /, anda'wo:ta/ adj. 水下的 tricycle /`traisikl/ n. 三轮车 compete /kam'pi:t/ v. 比赛，对抗 yard /ja:d/ n. 码 gasp /ga:sp/ v. 喘气 实验证明，儿童在很小的时候就可以开始学习游泳。 在洛杉矶的一个特设的游泳池里，孩子们甚至在还没有学会走路时就已经能熟练地在水下屏住呼吸了。 两个月的婴儿并未显得不愿意入水。 他们很快便适应了游泳，以致能捡起池底的物品。 这些幼小的游泳运动员非常喜爱的一种游戏是水下三轮车比赛。 三轮车并排放在7英尺深的游泳池底上。 孩子们比赛看谁先到达游泳池的另一端。 很多孩子用脚蹬车，但多数孩子更愿意推或是拉着三轮车。 有些孩子能够跑完游泳池的全长而不用露出水面换气。 他们将来是否能成为奥林匹克的冠军，这只能由时间来作出回答。 与此同时，他们对我们中的那些游不了5码就已喘不过气来的人应该是种鼓舞。

sec_cq94j8-d142-wtb: xin概念 lesson 96 the dead return. sec_cq94j8-d142-wtb lesson 96 the dead return 96 亡灵返乡 what happens to the lanterns at the end of the festival? a festival for the dead is held once a year in japan. this festival is a cheerful occasion, for on this day, the dead are said to return to their homes and they are welcomed by the living. as they are expected to be hungry after their long journey, food is laid out for them. specially-made lanterns are hung outside each house to help the dead to find their way. all night long, people dance and sing. in the early morning, the food thathadbeenlaidoutforthedeadisthrownintoa river or into the sea as it is considered unlucky for anyone living to eat it. in towns that are near the sea, the tiny lanterns which had been hung in the streets the night before, are placed into the water when the ___. to sea guiding the dead on their return journey to the festivalisover. 参考译文 thousandsoflanternsslowlydriftout other world. 日本每年过一次“亡灵节”。 this is a moving spectacle, for crowds of 这个节日是个 people stand on the shore watching the lanterns 欢乐的日子，因为在这一天，据说死去的 drifting away until they can be seen no more. 人要回到他们的家里来，活着的人则对他 new words and expressions 生词和短语 festival /'festivl/ n． 节日 lantern /"lantan/ n． 灯笼 spectacle /`spektakl/n． 景象,壮观,场面 们表示欢迎。 因为预料到他们在经过长途旅行之后会感到饥饿，所以为他们摆放好了食品。 特制的灯笼挂在各家的门外，为的是帮助亡灵看清道路。 整个夜晚人们载歌载舞。 一大早，人们便把为死者摆放的食品扔进河中或海里，因为人们认为活着的人吃了这些东西是不吉利的。 在海的城镇中，头天夜里挂在大街小巷的小灯笼在节后就放在了水里。 成千上万只灯笼慢慢漂向大海，指引着亡灵返回另一个世界。 这是一个感人的场面，人们成群地仁立在海岸上，注视着灯笼远去，直到再也看不见为止。
sec_cq94j8-d001-f6g: xin概念 lesson 1 a puma at large sec_cq94j8-d001-f6g lesson 1 apumaatlarge 逃遁的美洲狮 pumas are large, cat-like animals which are found in america. when reports came into london zoo that a wild puma had been spotted forty-five miles south of london, they were not taken seriously. however, as the evidence began to accumulate, experts from the zoo felt obliged to investigate, for the descriptions given by people who claimed to have seen the puma were extraordinarily similar. the hunt for the puma began in a small village where a woman pickingblackberriessaw'a largecat'only fiveyards awayfromher. it immediately ran away when she saw it, and experts confirmed that a puma will not attack a human being unless it is cornered. the search proved difficult, for the puma was often observed at one place in the morning and at another place twenty miles away in the evening. wherever it went, it left behind it a trail of dead deer and small animals like rabbits. paw prints were seen in a number of places and puma fur was found clinging to bushes. several people complained of 'cat-like noises' at night and a businessman on a fishing trip saw the puma up a tree. the experts were now fully convinced that the animal was a puma, but where had it come from? as no pumas had been reported missing from any zoo in the country, this one must have been in the possession of a private collector and somehow managed to escape. the hunt went on for several weeks, but the puma was not caught. it is disturbing to think that a dangerous wild animal is still at large in the quiet countryside.
sec_cq94j8-d244-9c9: xin概念 lesson 2 thirteen equals one sec_cq94j8-d244-9c9 lesson thirteene 十三等于一 equals one our vicar is always raising money for one cause or another, but he has never managed to get enough money tohave the churchclockrepaired. the big clock which used to strike the hours day and night was damaged many years ago and has been silent ever since. one night, however, our vicar woke up with a start: the clock was striking the hours! looking at his watch, he saw that it was one o'clock, but the bell struck thirteen times before it stopped. armed with a torch, thevicar went up into the clock tower to see what was going on. in the torchlight, he caught sight of a figure whom he immediately recognized asbill wilkins, our local grocer. 'whatever are you doing up here bill?' asked the vicar in surprise. 'i'm trying to repair the bell,' answered bill. 'i've been coming up here night after night for weeks now. you see, i was hoping to give you a surprise' 'you certainly did give me a surprise!' said the vicar. 'you've probably woken up everyone in the village as well. still, i'm glad the bell is working again.' 'that's the trouble, vicar,' answered bill. 'it's working all right, but i'm afraid that at one o'clock it will strike thirteen times and there's nothing i can do about it.' 'we'll get used to that, bill,' said the vicar. 'thirteen is not as good as one, but it's better than nothing. now let's go downstairs and have a cup of tea'
